scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team adopts a non-blocking Lintwise trial in its monorepo, agreeing beforehand on acceptable CI overhead and rule-level promotion criteria. The trial will assess actionable findings, false positives, remediation effort, message clarity, and coverage gaps; measure CI duration and queue wait; and test caching, tuning, baseline mode, and known bug cases. Any later required checks must be approved individually, with documented dispute and exception processes, ownership, and rollback triggers.

objectors.reason: The motion still mandates checks everywhere, while the discussion favors a non-blocking trial before deciding which rules should block merges.
The motion still mandates a blanket merge gate; it should first be amended to a non-blocking trial with evidence-based promotion of individual rules, clear exceptions, and a rollback path.

chairQuestions.topic: Findings and CI overhead in prior use
chairQuestions.experience_sought: During your six months using Lintwise, what kinds of real bugs did it catch, and how was the roughly four-minute CI increase measured?
What specific useful or incorrect JavaScript findings did you encounter, and what effort did they take to resolve?
